#!/bin/sh
set -eu

CERT_ROOT=/etc/nginx/tls
CURRENT_CERT="$CERT_ROOT/current/server.crt"
RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS=604800
VALIDITY_DAYS=30

force=0
if [ "$#" -eq 1 ] && [ "$1" = "--force" ]; then
    force=1
fi
if [ "$force" -eq 0 ] && [ -r "$CURRENT_CERT" ] &&
   openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS" -noout -in "$CURRENT_CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi

node_ip=$(cat "$CERT_ROOT/node-ip")
version=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$
new_dir="$CERT_ROOT/versions/$version"
new_link="$CERT_ROOT/.current.$$"
mkdir -m 700 "$new_dir"
trap 'rm -f "$new_link"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 \
    -sha256 -days "$VALIDITY_DAYS" -nodes \
    -subj "/CN=node1" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$new_dir/server.key" \
    -out "$new_dir/server.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 600 "$new_dir/server.key"
chmod 644 "$new_dir/server.crt"

cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$new_dir/server.crt" -pubkey -noout |
    openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in "$new_dir/server.key" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null |
    sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ]
openssl x509 -checkend 1209600 -noout -in "$new_dir/server.crt" >/dev/null

ln -s "versions/$version" "$new_link"
mv -Tf "$new_link" "$CERT_ROOT/current"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

if rc-service nginx status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nginx -t
    nginx -s reload
fi
logger -t nginx-cert-renew "installed certificate version $version"
